name: 변수 관계 탐색 방법 비교
research_question: Do META STAT and corrected GDN contribute stable unique and functionally useful candidate relations?
comparison: META versus STAT versus historical and corrected GDN under frozen normal-only criteria
dataset_scope: HAI 23.05 P1 normal train1-train4; no test or labels
current_evidence: The frozen EXP-01 decision demoted GDN to ablation because primary mask pair count was zero and selected META_PLUS_STAT as the V2A discovery policy.
result_scope: Normal-only contribution experiment; no attack detection or held-out result.
primary_metrics: Seed and split stability; unique confirmed-relation contribution; masking and Top-K sensitivity
limitations: The negative result is scope-bound and does not establish that GDN is generally useless.
next_action: Use META_PLUS_STAT for V2A and preserve GDN only as an ablation unless a separately preregistered experiment qualifies.
claim_impact: Current EXP-01 evidence does not support GDN as the primary V2 discovery authority.

name: GDN Prediction-XAI 추가 검증
research_question: Which GDN evidence arm most stably ranks normal-confirmed relations?
comparison: Embedding versus Attention versus EdgeMask versus Source Occlusion versus Functional-Consensus at equal budgets
dataset_scope: HAI 23.05 P1 normal train1-train4; 144-pair arm-blind normal relation reference
current_evidence: Nine CUDA runs completed. At K=29 the augmented ranking moved confirmed-pair yield 20 to 21 and NDCG 0.7427828733 to 0.7628608206, but split stability, positive median EdgeMask, and unique executable-rule criteria failed.
result_scope: Normal-only model-evidence comparison; not detection validation or causal ground truth.
primary_metrics: Precision Recall NDCG and confirmed yield at K; seed and split Jaccard; EdgeMask and matched-random effect; Formal V4 rule conversion
limitations: Three GDN-unique confirmed pairs produced zero unique executable rule pairs; combined improvement did not hold across split views.
next_action: Keep GDN as ablation; do not create a primary V2B portfolio or generalize beyond this normal-only reference.
claim_impact: The frozen criteria do not support primary or supporting GDN contribution in this experiment.

name: 규칙 수치 기준 비교
research_question: Which preregistered normal-only numeric policy best satisfies the frozen train4 selection rule?
comparison: One common fixed policy versus 36 relation-specific normal-only policies
dataset_scope: HAI 23.05 P1 normal train1 train2 and train4; V2A 39-directional-relation cohort
current_evidence: All 37 candidates were evaluated; 28 were eligible. The frozen rule selected RELATION_SPECIFIC_NORMAL_ONLY_V1:n7-q0.90-s2-f0.05 and froze a 39-rule Formal V4 V2A portfolio.
result_scope: Normal-only selection only; attack utility and superiority remain unevaluated.
primary_metrics: Normal false-alarm seconds and episodes; coverage; retention; abstain; split variability
limitations: Selection is normal-only and cannot establish test1 or held-out detection benefit.
next_action: Proceed with the selected authority to label-blind EXP-04 predictions without retuning.
claim_impact: Numeric policy selection is supported under the frozen normal-only rule; detection utility remains unvalidated.

name: 검증 피드백 기반 규칙 생성 비교
research_question: Does bounded verifier feedback improve rule construction over deterministic one-shot and budget-matched controls?
comparison: T0 versus T1 versus T1-B versus T2
current_evidence: T0 T1 and T1-B accepted 42 of 42; T2 accepted 39 of 42. T2 performed zero feedback actions so feedback was not empirically exercised.
result_scope: One frozen construction cohort; validity and cost observations only.
primary_metrics: Accepted yield; no-rule count; issue distribution; feedback actions and recoveries; provider-call cost
limitations: The current cohort contains no exercised feedback-recovery path and utility was not tested in this comparison.
next_action: If retained then preregister an independent repairable cohort with a budget-matched T1-B control.
claim_impact: The four paths executed; agentic verifier-feedback advantage is not supported by this pilot.

name: 검증된 관계 규칙의 이상탐지 성능 비교
research_question: Can verified rules detect attacks while controlling normal false-alarm episodes alone or with a detector?
comparison: D0 detector-only versus D1 Rule-only versus D2 policies
dataset_scope: HAI 23.05 P1 INNER with 14 contiguous attack-event units; statistical independence not established; no OUTER result
current_evidence: Integrity-audited INNER results exist. D1 responded to 13 of 14 with high FAR; D2 V1 and V2 responded to 11 of 14 and recovered none of three D0 misses.
primary_metrics: Attack-event Recall; Normal FAR episodes/hour; secondary D0-miss recovery
limitations: Small event-unit count; high D1 FAR; negative D2 results; no held-out result; simple PCA-SPE baseline.
next_action: Expand independently evaluated event evidence and add a stronger multivariate detector after new preregistration.
claim_impact: Rule signal and D0-D1 complementarity are pilot observations; operational utility and fusion improvement are unsupported or unvalidated.

name: 규칙 설명의 일치성 검증
research_question: Does explanation output faithfully represent frozen rule trace numeric provenance and outcome without unsupported content?
comparison: Automated conformance across PASS FAIL and abstain; human usefulness is separate
dataset_scope: Synthetic and representative trace-grounded artifacts; no human study
current_evidence: A deterministic renderer and trace bindings are implemented and audited. A comprehensive explanation-consistency experiment has not run.
primary_metrics: Source and target match; direction and timing; provenance; outcome consistency; omission; unsupported content; reproducibility
limitations: Representative artifacts do not establish corpus-wide faithfulness or human understanding.
next_action: Preregister corpus-level faithfulness checks; add human evaluation only if thesis-essential.
claim_impact: Trace-grounded rendering is an implementation fact; broad faithfulness is conditional and human usefulness unvalidated.

name: 실시간 LLM 활용 비교
research_question: Can a future live-LLM arm be compared as an independent detector without receiving fixed-rule outcomes or ground truth?
comparison: Future R0 deterministic runtime versus separately authorized R1 live-LLM mode
dataset_scope: CONDITIONAL FUTURE; no current scientific result
current_evidence: The deployed fixed-rule runtime is LLM-free. No scientific authority establishes a real-time LLM detection comparison.
primary_metrics: To be preregistered after role input output latency cost and leakage boundaries are frozen
limitations: R1 must not receive R0 final alarm or normal outcome final violation or satisfaction test labels or ground truth.
next_action: Keep conditional and outside the current core contribution unless separately approved.
claim_impact: No live-LLM detection benefit claim is supportable; LLM-free wording applies only to the current fixed-rule runtime.
